description: Pradeshiya Sabha - Chilaw - Notification made under Section 33 of Chapter III of Public Cemetery and Private Cemetery Ordinance No. 57 of 1946
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of certain lands as public cemeteries. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, survey plans, and property locations (e.g., "Kahatagahakela Kajuwatta and Hikgahawatta" land, survey plans 7714 and 224). While it mentions the Governor's authority, the core content focuses on land designation for cemetery use rather than government personnel changes or structural reforms. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
